DEROULEMENT.DESCRIPTION: The competition runs over a full annual period and is based on a monthly ranking system. It allows participants to submit their best performance each month under standardized and fair conditions. Throughout the year, shooters may submit an unlimited number of entries, subject to compliance with shooting, validation, and target sheet submission rules. Results are then processed by the organization to establish monthly rankings, and then the final annual ranking, which determines prize recipients at the annual general meeting.

PROCEDURE_TIR.DECISION: At the end of the shooting session, the shooter must return the target sheets (used or NOT) to the range employee.
PROCEDURE_TIR.LIMITE_MENSUELLE: Only one target sheet per shooter is accepted per month: the sheet with the best score including bonus points.
PROCEDURE_TIR.DELAI: The target sheet must be submitted on the same day it was shot; any later submission will be refused.

FEUILLES.OBTENTION: The shooter must obtain an official target sheet from the range employee.
FEUILLES.PARTICIPATIONS: The number of entries is not limited during the year.

VALIDATION.ESTAMPILLE: Each sheet must be stamped by the employee upon issuance.
VALIDATION.DISTANCE: Targets must be positioned at a distance of 25 meters.
VALIDATION.REFUS_SIGNATURE: In case of non-compliance with the distance, the official will not be able to sign, and the sheet will be considered invalid.

TRAITEMENT.CALCUL_MANUEL: Point calculation is performed manually by the organization's managers.
TRAITEMENT.SAISIE_EXCEL: Results are entered into a Microsoft Excel spreadsheet.
TRAITEMENT.PUBLICATION: The final ranking and prize giving to the top three shooters take place at the annual general meeting.
TRAITEMENT.PRE_PUBLICATION: The provisional ranking is published during the first week of the following month, no later than the first Saturday.
TRAITEMENT.PRIX: Prizes are awarded based on the official ranking established at the end of the competition.
TRAITEMENT.PRIX_DETAIL: For details on distinctions, trophies, and rewards associated with each position, please refer to the section "
TRAITEMENT.PRIX_DETAIL2: ", which specifies the evaluation criteria as well as the prizes awarded according to the ranking obtained.

TIRAGE.PARTICIPATIONS: Every target sheet purchased and returned automatically grants an entry right, whether used (shot) or not.
TIRAGE.EXPLICATION: The 50/50 draw is performed only when the cumulative amount reaches a minimum of $100.
TIRAGE.AUCUN: No draw is conducted on a monthly or periodic basis if this threshold is not reached.
TIRAGE.EQUITABLE: The draw is performed electronically using a random selection module integrated directly into the official competition application (digital wheel of fortune), ensuring an impartial, transparent, and fair process.

TIRPARFAIT.DESCRIPTION: The shooter hits the center of the target without error and makes the center point completely disappear. They obtain 10 base points and 1 bonus point.

TIRSOLIDE.DESCRIPTION: The shooter hits the center of the target without error, but does not make the center point completely disappear. They obtain 10 base points.

TIRINVALIDE.DESCRIPTION: The shot contains an error: double shot on the same target or off-target shot (within the frame but outside the scoring zone). No points are awarded.

TIRTRICHE.DESCRIPTION: A target is modified, replaced, or manipulated to artificially improve the score.
